priceSnapshot.note: Up +0.37% since this morning's close (84,181.1 -> 84,491.6). Note on timing: midday's report (2026-09-26-midday.json) landed only ~40 seconds before this endday snapshot -- both sessions caught up from a scheduling backlog nearly simultaneously, so the vs-midday delta is noise (84,491.9 -> 84,491.6, essentially the same live tick). The meaningful comparison is against this morning's 06:55 COT report, six-plus hours earlier: session range since morning stayed a calm 83,818-84,571.4 -- both reduceIf 82,874.5 and addIf 84,944.4 remain untested for a 7th straight session. Funding flipped slightly negative (+0.00074% at morning -> -0.0021% now, confirmed independently by both midday and this run) while the OKX top-trader L/S account ratio ticked up marginally (1.32 -> 1.33) and OI held essentially flat ($2,387.7M -> $2,385.4M) -- a quiet Saturday grind, no fresh catalyst.

reduceIf.confirmation: Unchanged since the Sep-24 flush -- untested for a 7th straight session. A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 would end the hold and signal the recovery has failed. Session low since morning (83,818) stayed well clear.

addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since Sep-25 morning -- still capped by the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick. A settled 1H close above 84,944.4 would confirm the range top is breaking. Session high since morning (84,571.4) pressed closer but stayed under it.

decisionBox.changed: No level change: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched, now unbroken for a 7th straight session. Today's midday report ran only ~40s before this one (a scheduling backlog caught both sessions up together), so there is no real vs-midday delta -- comparing instead to this morning, six-plus hours earlier: funding flipped negative (+0.00074% -> -0.0021%), L/S account ratio ticked up slightly (1.32 -> 1.33), OI roughly flat ($2,387.7M -> $2,385.4M), Fear & Greed cooled (this run read 70, vs 74 at both midnight and midday's independent reads a little earlier -- alternative.me's daily index appears to have rolled over between those checks and this one). Momentum is mixed across timeframes: 1H MACD hist kept building (+36.45 -> +40.61), 4H hist improved further (-161.97 at midnight -> -44.94 now, the deceleration continuing), but daily MACD hist ticked DOWN for the first time in two sessions (256.50 at morning -> 190.48 now, essentially flat vs midday's 191.16) and 15m hist flipped negative (+5.91 -> -8.685) as price stalled into the close. Net effect: short/medium-term structure still improving since morning, but the daily move that had been building for two sessions paused -- position stays HOLD, defensive into the overnight gap rather than chasing the stall.

overnightRisk: Quiet weekend setup heading into the ~6.5h gap to tomorrow's 02:00 COT midnight report, but liquidity thins further overnight and Saturday-into-Sunday books amplify any surprise. The only fresh liquidation cluster in OKX's last-100-fills sample sits essentially AT spot, just above it at 84,500 (short liqs, ~1.28 BTC / ~$108k) -- a push through addIf 84,944.4 could accelerate into a short squeeze with little resistance until 85,258.8. Below spot, the free feed shows no fresh cluster: downside toward 83,500 / 82,874.5 currently lacks a resting magnet in realized liquidations, though thin weekend order books can still produce outsized wicks on any surprise headline (Fed speaker, geopolitical escalation, or a single large market order) even without one. Funding flipped mildly negative and Fear & Greed eased 74->70, both consistent with the range continuing rather than resolving overnight. No live stop is placed (paper wallet is spot-only this session, futures already flat) -- invalidatesAt 82,500 remains the de facto line for the spot-core thesis; a settled break there before midnight would flip the bias to bearish.
